# Sancho Godinho

> Sancho Godinho is a software developer, cybersecurity researcher, DevOps and infrastructure enthusiast, and open-source contributor based in Mumbai, India. This is his personal portfolio: https://sancho.sg-app.com

Last updated: 2026-11-20

Sancho Godinho builds web applications, developer tools, CLIs, bots, and infrastructure. His work combines software development with security research and responsible disclosure. He is currently open to software development, open-source, developer tooling, and technology roles in Mumbai or remote.

## Professional experience

- **Community Manager & Open Source Software Developer**, Dodo Payments (October 2025 – October 2026, part-time, remote; past role). Managed the Dodo Payments Discord community and was a core maintainer of the Dodo Payments CLI, Discord bot, migration tool, and sync engine.
- **Open to work** (November 2026 – present): on-site roles in Mumbai or remote roles in software development, open source, developer tooling, and technology-focused teams.

## Technical skills

The website groups skills as:

- **Expert:** Bun, Node.js, Socket.io, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailscale, server management, infrastructure optimization, server security.
- **Proficient:** React, Expo, Python, Bash, MongoDB, Docker, UFW.
- **Practices:** RESTful API design, WebSocket communication, security best practices, Git and version control, responsive web design, performance optimization.
- **Also listed in the site's structured data:** TypeScript, React Native, Linux, DevOps, web security, vulnerability research, and responsible disclosure.

## Projects

- [s0](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/s0) — Fast CLI subdomain finder built with Bun. Tech stack: Bun, MongoDB, Redis, Expo. Source: https://github.com/sancho1952007/s0
- [Postily](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Postily) — Creator-focused next-generation social media platform (under development). Tech stack: Bun, MongoDB, Redis, Expo, Elysia. Website: https://postily.social
- [Bunserv](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Bunserv) — High-performance, minimalist static file server CLI built with Bun. Tech stack: Bun, CLI. Source: https://github.com/sancho1952007/bunserv
- [VibedIn](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/VibedIn) — Connect with like-minded users on X based on shared interests. Tech stack: Bun, MongoDB, Webhooks, X API. Website: https://vibedin.sg-app.com
- [Serverbay](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Serverbay) — Marketplace for VPS, VDS, and dedicated servers across individual and commercial sellers. Tech stack: Bun, MongoDB, Next.js. Website: https://serverbay.sg-app.com
- [Smart Notes](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Smart%20Notes) — Real-time collaborative cloud notepad with rich text support. Shut down. Tech stack: Node.js, MongoDB, WebSockets.
- [SG Apps](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/SG%20Apps) — Portfolio and hub for custom-built applications. Website: https://sg-app.com
- [Tiles Game](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Tiles%20Game) — Lightweight, casual browser game. Tech stack: HTML, CSS, JS. Website: https://sg-app.com/Tiles-Game/
- [Encli](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Encli) — Cross-platform CLI file encryption and decryption utility. Tech stack: Node.js, CLI. Source: https://github.com/sancho1952007/Encli
- [Clokie](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Clokie) — Customizable clock for display. Tech stack: HTML, CSS, JS. Website: https://sancho1952007.github.io/Clokie/
- [AOS Web](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/AOS%20Web) — OS-like system made with web technology. Tech stack: HTML, CSS, JS. Website: https://sancho1952007.github.io/AOS-Web/
- [Modern GUI](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Modern%20GUI) — Window replacement for Tkinter (Python) apps. Tech stack: Python, Tkinter. Source: https://github.com/sancho1952007/Modern-GUI-v3.0
- [iPhone 11 Clone](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/iPhone%2011%20Clone) — iPhone 11 Pro made using only HTML and CSS. Tech stack: HTML, CSS. Website: https://sancho1952007.github.io/iPhone-11-Clone/

## Open-source contributions

Sancho Godinho is an active open-source contributor. He was a core maintainer at Dodo Payments for the CLI, Discord bot, migration tool, and sync engine, and has contributed to projects including Dokploy, Elysia.js, and other projects. The most complete index is his GitHub profile: https://github.com/sancho1952007

Selected public repositories:

- s0, subdomain finder: https://github.com/sancho1952007/s0
- Bunserv, static file server built with Bun: https://github.com/sancho1952007/bunserv
- Modern GUI, Tkinter window replacement: https://github.com/sancho1952007/Modern-GUI-v3.0
- Dodo Payments CLI: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodopayments-cli
- Dodo Payments migration tool: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-migrate
- Dodo Payments sync engine: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-sync

## Security research

Sancho Godinho performs responsible vulnerability research and reporting. Organizations whose products he has reported vulnerabilities in include Amazon, LemonSqueezy, Dodo Payments, Crazy Games, Smash Karts, and Codesphere. No CVE identifiers, severity ratings, bounties, awards, or formal acknowledgements are claimed on this site.
